items.title: U.S. pressure campaign cuts Iran’s banking and air links as war drags on - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. is intensifying efforts to isolate Iran from international banking and aviation networks, with several regional governments cutting financial and air links with Tehran amid the continuing war, the Wall Street Journal reported exclusively.

items.title: Citigroup (C) Enters Commerce Media With New Advertising Platform
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) introduced Citi Commerce Media, a new advertising and data platform targeting brands that want access to its U.S. cardholders. The bank plans to acquire rewards platform Kard to integrate its merchant and offer technology into Citi Commerce Media. Citi Commerce Media aims to use Citi's U.S. credit card transaction data to help advertisers reach consumers with more targeted campaigns.
